Q (Designer's Note). GW's Swarmlord datasheet (Wahapedia) prints, under Malign Presence (Aura): "Designer’s Note: This ability takes precedence over the Lord of Deceit ability presented in the Balance Dataslate June 2024." FP 1.3's "Change to" replaces the ability's text; it does not say it removes the note. Treating the note as void because the ability's words changed is a reading of the rules, and the owner's rules are show everything, marked, and quote rather than interpret. Recommendation: show it as a note on Malign Presence, marked, e.g. "Designer’s Note (Wahapedia’s datasheet, printed under the codex wording that Faction Pack 1.3 replaced): “This ability takes precedence over the Lord of Deceit ability presented in the Balance Dataslate June 2024.”" (on the shared Swarmlord row, so nidzillas too). Not ok as "left out"; the judgement changes kind, so there is no exact fix value. If the owner decides an outdated 10th-edition dataslate note is noise, leaving it out is defensible, but say so on screen (marked, not hidden).
